title: FullMeta UI Plot 2D Data 1
description: Application-neutral scalar plots in a 2D coordinate domain: triangle or polygon surfaces, or a regular row-major raster grid with coordinate axes. Raster-grid plots use independent wheel zoom, drag pan, and double-click reset; the shared widget repaints only the affected plot viewport, while callers may supply annotations that follow the view.

background.description: Optional CSS color used to clear the plot canvas.

direction.description: Direction in which coordinate values increase on screen; use down for image-row coordinates.

values.description: Row-major scalar values. Screen placement of rows follows yAxis.direction; row zero is at the top when direction is down.

position.description: Two coordinates for a flat plot; an optional third coordinate lets a host reuse a 3D world-space projection.

face.description: Vertex indexes describing a polygon face; the renderer triangulates faces with more than three vertices.

range.description: Optional minimum and maximum for the scalar color range.
